item.title: Daily Minute — November 19, 2026
item.description: [12] “I am upset because I see a meaningless world.” Insane thoughts are upsetting, they produce a world in which there is no order anywhere. Only chaos rules a world which represents chaotic thinking, and chaos has no laws. I cannot live in peace in such a world. item.title: Lesson 139: “I will accept Atonement for myself.”
item.description: “I will accept Atonement for myself.” Here is the end of choice. For here we come to a decision to accept ourselves as God created us.
